extensions.accessibility: Orange 2px focus outline with 6px offset. Reduced motion removes automatic animation and smooth scrolling. Lens rendering parks offscreen and when the document is hidden; manual range rotation remains available. Clue connections have a touch and keyboard reveal button; mouse scanning is limited to fine-pointer desktop devices.
extensions.scrolling: Landing-only html/body :has(.shift-landing) overrides release the application body scroll lock for native document scrolling.

components.html: Find your next move

components.name: Story tab
components.description: Outlined unselected pill; ink selected state on paper.

narrative.overview: For /landing only: the authentic orange logo, investigator mascot, and Always one step ahead slogan anchor ink and paper chapters. A supporting Three.js lens and a cursor magnifier explain how fictional public artifacts reveal a connected campaign. Content remains readable independently of motion.
keyCharacteristics: Grotesk slogan and italic serif emphasis
Fictional clue-board connections with mouse, touch, and keyboard access
Native scrolling and controlled optical motion

rules.name: The Field Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep the implemented paper-text contrast; dark-field muted text does not transfer to paper.

dos: Do keep the system scoped to /landing.
Do keep demo findings explicitly illustrative.
Do preserve focus, reduced motion, and real signup/login routes.
Do preserve the supplied logo and mascot assets.
donts: Don't reintroduce the removed hero eyebrow or audience numbering.
Don't fabricate an approved comp or adopt exploratory FORM output as authority.
